newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Cardoso surprised by Menem comments.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Cardoso surprised by Menem comments.

text.p: President Fernando Henrique Cardoso was "surprised" by criticism from Argentine counterpart Carlos Menem of Brazil's bid for a seat on an expanded United Nations Security Council, an official said on Monday.

Menem said in a newspaper interview published on Sunday that he opposed Brazil's push for a place on the Security Council, should it be reformed to accept new members. Menem told O Estado de Sao Paulo that such a move would "break the balance we currently have in the region."

A spokesman for Cardoso told reporters on Monday evening "the president was surprised by the declaration" and that "if it were Argentina seeking a place on the Council, Brazil would provide its support."
Argentina, Brazil's longtime rival for leadership in the region, has argued that South American nations should take turns on any expanded Security Council.
